reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "For most healthy adults, up to about 400 mg of caffeine a day is considered fine, which is roughly three or four cups of coffee. Before training, one or two cups about 30 to 60 minutes out is plenty. If you get jittery, a racing heart or sleep trouble, go lower and keep it out of the afternoon. If you have a heart condition or take medication, check with your doctor."}
